# Sara Portfolio Project Instructions

This is a modern, accessible single-page portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Tech Stack
- React with Vite
- TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS
- Framer Motion for animations
- EmailJS for contact form
- React Hook Form for form handling
- React Scroll for smooth navigation

## Accessibility Requirements
- Perfect accessibility score (WCAG 2.1 AA compliance)
- Semantic HTML elements
- Proper ARIA labels and roles
- Keyboard navigation support
- Screen reader compatibility
- High contrast ratios
- Focus management

## Project Structure
- Single-page application with smooth scrolling
- Sections: Hero, About, Projects, Contact
- Contact form sends to: itsjamelscott@gmail.com
- Modern, responsive design
- No database required

## Development Guidelines
- Use semantic HTML5 elements
- Implement proper heading hierarchy
- Add skip links for keyboard users
- Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
- Use proper alt text for images
- Maintain color contrast ratios above 4.5:1
- Test with screen readers
